newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Public Bank FRCD raised to HK$1.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Public Bank FRCD raised to HK$1.2 bln.

text.p: Public Bank Bhd's floating rate certificate of deposit issue due 2000 has been increased to HK$1.2 billion from HK$1.0 billion, arranger Sanwa International Finance said on Wednesday.

The three-year certificates were issued at par to float at 25 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 32 basis points.
Arrangers, with HK$90 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia, HSBC Markets, Sanwa International Finance, Standard Chartered Bank and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).
Co-lead managers, with HK$80 million each, are Dresdner Bank's Labuan branch, NORD/LB's Singapore branch, Royal Bank of Scotland's Singapore branch and SGZ Bank.

Senior managers, with HK$60 million each, are Asahi Finance (Hong Kong), Banco Central Hispanoamericano's Hongkong branch, Banco Exterior de Espana's Hongkong branch, Bank of East Asia and Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank's Singapore branch.
Co-managers are Banca Commerciale Italiana's Singapore branch, with HK$60 million, Credito Italiano's Singapore branch, with HK$40 million, and Banca di Roma's Hongkong branch, with HK$30 million.
Signing is set for June 27. The payment date is July 7.
